segments.vv67:1.3: Kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā, veḷuriyathambhā rucakatthatā subhā.
segments.vv67:2.1: “Tatthacchasi pivasi khādasi ca, dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ;
segments.vv67:2.3: Aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā, dibbā ca kaññā tidasacarā uḷārā;
segments.vv67:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv67:4.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv67:5.3: So hi pamodati [modati (sī. syā. pī.)] saggagato tidive [tattha (ka.)], anubhoti ca puññaphalaṃ vipulaṃ.
segments.vv67:6.1: “Tavevāhaṃ [tathevāhaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] mahāmuni, adāsiṃ caturo phale.
segments.vv67:7.1: “Tasmā hi phalaṃ alameva dātuṃ, niccaṃ manussena sukhatthikena;
segments.vv67:7.3: Dibbāni vā patthayatā sukhāni, manussasobhaggatamicchatā vā.

lines: Sādhurūpāti rūpasampattiyā ca sīlācārasampattiyā ca sikkhāsampattiyā ca sundarasabhāvā.
Phaladāyīti attanā ambaphalassa dinnattā attānaṃ sandhāya vadati.
Saggagatoti uppajjanavasena saggaṃ gato, tatthāpi tidive tāvatiṃsabhavane anubhoti ca puññaphalaṃ vipulaṃ yathāhaṃ, evaṃ aññopīti attho.
Tasmāti yasmā catunnaṃ phalānaṃ dānamattena īdisī sampatti adhigatā, tasmā.
